pixel_convention: full-resolution pixels, origin top-left, x right, y down; time t = frame/24

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the tree band vs frame 0: shift < 0.05 px for all frames)
camera.view: elevated camera looking obliquely down at flat bare forest floor; no horizon or sky visible
camera.focal_length: unknown - estimate from depth_info + known size (see notes.md)
camera.perspective_cues: flat ground plane; far objects are higher in the image. Forklift apparent size shrinks as it drives up-left (away from camera): bbox height 780 -> 510 px, orange-centroid track is straight in image (line cy = 0.468*cx + 86.5, max residual 7 px)

objects.name: forklift
objects.description: yellow/orange forklift with black roll cage, mast and two orange forks; the only moving object
objects.occluded: never; fully in frame in all frames (frame 0 wheel bottom at y~1424, 16 px from the bottom edge)
objects.motion: drives forks-first in a straight line toward the upper left (away from the camera), image direction about -156 deg (atan2(dy,dx), y down), i.e. left and up at slope dy/dx = 0.468
objects.reference_point: orange_cx/orange_cy (centroid of orange body pixels: smoothest, about 1 px noise) or centroid_x/y (full mask centroid, 2-4 px noise); the true vehicle root is probably at ground level under the body - see ground_root_estimates

objects.name: left_pine
objects.description: small conifer at left, full tree visible

objects.name: centre_bush_tree
objects.description: leafy broad-leaf bush/young tree top centre with a thick bare trunk rising out of the top of the frame behind it
objects.note: leaves extend to y~52; the trunk continues above the frame (height not measurable)

objects.name: right_pine
objects.description: conifer at right edge, cut by the right image border

objects.name: ground
objects.description: flat bare dirt/leaf-litter ground with diagonal tree-shadow stripes (static, cast by off-screen trees)

events.note: frame 0->1 step 0.2 px, 1->2 1.3 px; image speed rises roughly linearly

events.event: forklift image speed stops increasing (reaches ~26 px/frame)
events.note: approximate (frames 45-52); after that image speed ~26 px/frame until the end; apparent size keeps shrinking, so world speed may still rise

events.event: clip ends with forklift still moving

apparent_size_vs_time: per-frame bbox_w, bbox_h, mask_len_major, mask_wid_minor, mask_area_px in tracks/forklift.csv; bbox_h falls 780 (f0) -> 690 (f36) -> 510 (f71); size ratio ~ inverse depth ratio
